  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F008",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary of Health and Human Services must establish procedures regarding the disposition of intangible assets and program income that permit such assets acquired with, and program income derived from, grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act (42 U.S.C. 9921) to become the sole property of such grantees after a period of not more than 12 years after the end of the grant period for any activity consistent with section 680(a)(2)(A) of the CSBG Act (42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)), applicable to such grant funds made available after November 29, 1999.",
        "actor": "Secretary [of Health and Human Services]",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary [of Health and Human Services]",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Applicable to grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act made available after November 29, 1999.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F008"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9921", "42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F008",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Intangible assets in the form of loans, equity investments and other debt instruments, and program income may be used by grantees for any eligible purpose consistent with section 680(a)(2)(A) of the CSBG Act (42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)).",
        "actor": "grantees",
        "actor_quote": "grantees",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "For grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act made available after November 29, 1999.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F008"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F034:F037",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary may, through grants to public and private, nonprofit agencies, provide for community-based, local, statewide, and national programs to coordinate private and public food assistance resources, wherever the grant recipient involved determines such coordination to be inadequate, to better serve low-income populations; to assist low-income communities to identify potential sponsors of child nutrition programs and to initiate such programs in underserved or unserved areas; and to develop innovative approaches at the State and local level to meet the nutrition needs of low-income individuals.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F040:F044",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Of the amount appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out 42 U.S.C. 9922 (not to exceed $6,000,000), the Secretary must distribute funds for grants under subsection (a) by allotting from a 60 percent portion (not to exceed $3,600,000) for grants to eligible agencies for statewide programs in each State the amount bearing the same ratio to that portion as the low-income and unemployed population of such State bears to the low-income and unemployed population of all States, and by making grants from a 40 percent portion (not to exceed $2,400,000) on a competitive basis to eligible agencies for local and statewide programs.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Of the amount appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out this section (not to exceed $6,000,000).",
        "scope_quotes": ["F040"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9922(a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F046:F052",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Any amounts appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out 42 U.S.C. 9922 in excess of $6,000,000 must be allotted as follows: the Secretary must use 40 percent of such excess to allot for grants under subsection (a) to eligible agencies for statewide programs in each State an amount bearing the same ratio to 40 percent of such excess as the low-income and unemployed population of such State bears to the low-income and unemployed population of all the States; the Secretary must use 40 percent of such excess to make grants under subsection (a) on a competitive basis to eligible agencies for local and statewide programs; and the Secretary must use the remaining 20 percent of such excess to make grants under subsection (a) on a competitive basis to eligible agencies for nationwide programs, including programs benefiting Indians (as defined in 42 U.S.C. 9911) and migrant or seasonal farmworkers.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Any amounts appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out this section in excess of $6,000,000.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F046"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9911", "42 U.S.C. 9922(a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F055",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "To be eligible to receive an allotment under paragraph (1)(A) or (2)(A) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b), an eligible agency must demonstrate that the proposed program is statewide in scope and represents a comprehensive and coordinated effort to alleviate hunger within the State.",
        "actor": "eligible agency",
        "actor_quote": "eligible agency",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "To be eligible to receive an allotment under paragraph (1)(A) or (2)(A).",
        "scope_quotes": ["F055"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(1)(A)", "42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(2)(A)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F058:F061",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term_state_cfnp"],
        "statement": "From the amounts allotted under paragraphs (1)(A) and (2)(A) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b), the minimum total allotment for each State for each fiscal year must be $15,000 if the total amount appropriated to carry out this section is not less than $7,000,000 but less than $10,000,000; $20,000 if the total amount appropriated to carry out this section is not less than $10,000,000 but less than $15,000,000; or $30,000 if the total amount appropriated to carry out this section is not less than $15,000,000.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(1)(A)", "42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(2)(A)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F063",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "term_state_cfnp",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In paragraph (4) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b), the term “State” does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this paragraph [42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(4)].",
        "scope_quotes": ["F063"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(4)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F066",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "From funds made available under paragraphs (1)(B) and (2)(B) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b) for any fiscal year, the Secretary must not make grants under subsection (a) to an eligible agency in an aggregate amount exceeding $50,000, and from funds made available under paragraph (2)(C) for any fiscal year, the Secretary must not make grants under subsection (a) to an eligible agency in an aggregate amount exceeding $300,000.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9922(a)", "42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(1)(B)", "42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(2)(B)", "42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(2)(C)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F068:F071",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For each fiscal year, the Secretary must prepare and submit, to the Committee on Education and the Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Labor and Human Resources of the Senate, a report concerning the grants made under 42 U.S.C. 9922, including a list of grant recipients, information on the amount of funding awarded to each grant recipient, a summary of the activities performed by the grant recipients with funding awarded under this section, and a description of the manner in which such activities meet the objectives described in subsection (a).",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "For each fiscal year.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F068"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9922(a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F085",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary is authorized to make a grant to an eligible service provider to administer national or regional programs to provide instructional activities for low-income youth.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "authority",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "is authorized",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F085",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In making a grant to an eligible service provider to administer national or regional programs to provide instructional activities for low-income youth, the Secretary must give priority to eligible service providers that have a demonstrated ability to operate such a program.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In making such a grant.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F085"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F087:F094",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Any instructional activity carried out by an eligible service provider receiving a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9923 must be carried out on the campus of an institution of higher education (as defined in section 1141(a) of title 20) and must include: access to the facilities and resources of such an institution; an initial medical examination and follow-up referral or treatment, without charge, for youth during their participation in such activity; at least one nutritious meal daily, without charge, for participating youth during each day of participation; high quality instruction in a variety of sports (which must include swimming and may include dance and any other high quality recreational activity) provided by coaches and teachers from institutions of higher education and from elementary and secondary schools (as defined in section 7801 of title 20); and enrichment instruction and information on matters relating to the well-being of youth, including educational opportunities and information on study practices, education for the prevention of drug and alcohol abuse, and information on health and nutrition, career opportunities, and family and job responsibilities.",
        "actor": "eligible service provider receiving a grant under this section",
        "actor_quote": "eligible service provider receiving a grant under this section",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["20 U.S.C. 1141(a)", "20 U.S.C. 7801"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F096:F101",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The eligible service provider must, in each community in which a program is funded under 42 U.S.C. 9923, ensure that either a community-based advisory committee is established (with representatives from local youth, family, and social service organizations, schools, entities providing park and recreation services, and other community-based organizations serving high-risk youth) or an existing community-based advisory board, commission, or committee with similar membership is utilized to serve as that committee; and must enter into formal partnerships with youth-serving organizations or other appropriate social service entities in order to link program participants with year-round services in their home communities that support and continue the objectives of this chapter.",
        "actor": "eligible service provider",
        "actor_quote": "eligible service provider",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In each community in which a program is funded under this section.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F096"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": "The provider must ensure that either a new community-based advisory committee is established or an existing advisory board, commission, or committee with similar membership is utilized.",
        "choice_quote": "F097:F099",
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F103:F107",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "A service provider that is a national private, nonprofit organization, a coalition of such organizations, or a private, nonprofit organization applying jointly with a business concern is eligible to apply for a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9923 if the applicant has demonstrated experience in operating a program providing instruction to low-income youth; agrees to contribute an amount (in cash or in kind, fairly evaluated) of not less than 25 percent of the amount requested, for the program funded through the grant; agrees to use no funds from a grant authorized under this section for administrative expenses; and agrees to comply with the regulations or program guidelines promulgated by the Secretary for use of funds made available through the grant.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "If all specified conditions (1) through (4) are satisfied.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F103:F107"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F110",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "To be eligible to receive a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9923, a service provider must submit to the Secretary, for approval, an application at such time, in such manner, and containing such information as the Secretary may require.",
        "actor": "service provider",
        "actor_quote": "service provider",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "To be eligible to receive a grant under this section.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F110"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F113",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary must promulgate regulations or program guidelines to ensure funds made available through a grant made under 42 U.S.C. 9923 are used in accordance with the objectives of this chapter.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F135",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Any reference in any provision of law to the poverty line set forth in section 624 or 625 of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964 must be construed to be a reference to the poverty line defined in section 9902 of title 42.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9902"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F135",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except as otherwise provided, any reference in any provision of law to any community action agency designated under title II of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964 must be construed to be a reference to an entity eligible to receive funds under the community services block grant program.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Except as otherwise provided.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F135"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F146:F150",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term_eligible_entity_dpa", "term_secretary_dpa"],
        "statement": "In order to stimulate the development of new approaches to provide for greater self-sufficiency of the poor, to test and evaluate such new approaches, to disseminate project results and evaluation findings so that such approaches can be replicated, and to strengthen the integration, coordination, and redirection of activities to promote maximum self-sufficiency among the poor, the Secretary may make grants from funds appropriated under subsection (e) to eligible entities for the development and implementation of new and innovative approaches to deal with particularly critical needs or problems of the poor which are common to a number of communities, but grants may be made only with respect to applications that involve activities that can be incorporated into or closely coordinated with eligible entities' ongoing programs, involve significant new combinations of resources or new and innovative approaches involving partnership agreements, are structured to most fully and effectively promote the purposes of the Community Services Block Grant Act within the limits of the contemplated assistance or activities, and contain an assurance that the applicant will obtain an independent, methodologically sound evaluation of the effectiveness of the activities and submit it to the Secretary.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Only with respect to applications meeting the conditions in subparagraphs (A) through (D).",
        "scope_quotes": ["F146:F150"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9901 et seq.", "42 U.S.C. 9925(e)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F152",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term_secretary_dpa"],
        "statement": "No grant may be made under 42 U.S.C. 9925 unless an application is submitted to the Secretary at such time, in such manner, and containing or accompanied by such information, as the Secretary may require.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No grant may be made",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F153",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Initial and subsequent grant awards under 42 U.S.C. 9925 may fully fund projects for periods of up to 3 years.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,

        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F157",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Subject to subparagraph (B), grants awarded pursuant to 42 U.S.C. 9925 must be used for programs and must not exceed 50 per centum of the cost of such programs.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Subject to subparagraph (B).",
        "scope_quotes": ["F157"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9925(b)(1)(B)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F158",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term_eligible_entity_dpa"],
        "statement": "After the first funding period for which an eligible entity receives a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9925 to carry out a program, the amount of a subsequent grant made under this section to such entity to carry out such program must not exceed 80 percent of the amount of the grant previously received by such entity under this section to carry out such program.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": "After the first funding period for which an eligible entity receives a grant under this section to carry out a program.",
        "scope_quotes": ["F158"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F160",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Non-Federal contributions under 42 U.S.C. 9925 may be in cash or in kind, fairly evaluated, including but not limited to plant, equipment, or services.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,

        "choice_text": null,

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F161",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term_eligible_entity_dpa"],
        "statement": "Not more than one grant in each fiscal year may be made to any eligible entity, no grant may exceed $350,000, and not more than 2 grants may be made under 42 U.S.C. 9925 to an eligible entity to carry out a particular program.",
        "actor": null,

terms.label: Secretary
aliases: Secretary of Health and Human Services

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary of Health and Human Services must establish procedures regarding the disposition of intangible assets and program income that permit such assets acquired with, and program income derived from, grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act (42 U.S.C. 9921) to become the sole property of such grantees after a period of not more than 12 years after the end of the grant period for any activity consistent with section 680(a)(2)(A) of the CSBG Act (42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)), applicable to such grant funds made available after November 29, 1999.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applicable to grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act made available after November 29, 1999.

unit_attributes.statement: Intangible assets in the form of loans, equity investments and other debt instruments, and program income may be used by grantees for any eligible purpose consistent with section 680(a)(2)(A) of the CSBG Act (42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)).
unit_attributes.scope_text: For grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act made available after November 29, 1999.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary may, through grants to public and private, nonprofit agencies, provide for community-based, local, statewide, and national programs to coordinate private and public food assistance resources, wherever the grant recipient involved determines such coordination to be inadequate, to better serve low-income populations; to assist low-income communities to identify potential sponsors of child nutrition programs and to initiate such programs in underserved or unserved areas; and to develop innovative approaches at the State and local level to meet the nutrition needs of low-income individuals.

Of the amount appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out 42 U.S.C. 9922 (not to exceed $6,000,000), the Secretary must distribute funds for grants under subsection (a) by allotting from a 60 percent portion (not to exceed $3,600,000) for grants to eligible agencies for statewide programs in each State the amount bearing the same ratio to that portion as the low-income and unemployed population of such State bears to the low-income and unemployed population of all States, and by making grants from a 40 percent portion (not to exceed $2,400,000) on a competitive basis to eligible agencies for local and statewide programs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Of the amount appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out this section (not to exceed $6,000,000).

unit_attributes.statement: Any amounts appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out 42 U.S.C. 9922 in excess of $6,000,000 must be allotted as follows: the Secretary must use 40 percent of such excess to allot for grants under subsection (a) to eligible agencies for statewide programs in each State an amount bearing the same ratio to 40 percent of such excess as the low-income and unemployed population of such State bears to the low-income and unemployed population of all the States; the Secretary must use 40 percent of such excess to make grants under subsection (a) on a competitive basis to eligible agencies for local and statewide programs; and the Secretary must use the remaining 20 percent of such excess to make grants under subsection (a) on a competitive basis to eligible agencies for nationwide programs, including programs benefiting Indians (as defined in 42 U.S.C. 9911) and migrant or seasonal farmworkers.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Any amounts appropriated for a fiscal year to carry out this section in excess of $6,000,000.

unit_attributes.statement: To be eligible to receive an allotment under paragraph (1)(A) or (2)(A) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b), an eligible agency must demonstrate that the proposed program is statewide in scope and represents a comprehensive and coordinated effort to alleviate hunger within the State.
unit_attributes.scope_text: To be eligible to receive an allotment under paragraph (1)(A) or (2)(A).

unit_attributes.statement: From the amounts allotted under paragraphs (1)(A) and (2)(A) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b), the minimum total allotment for each State for each fiscal year must be $15,000 if the total amount appropriated to carry out this section is not less than $7,000,000 but less than $10,000,000; $20,000 if the total amount appropriated to carry out this section is not less than $10,000,000 but less than $15,000,000; or $30,000 if the total amount appropriated to carry out this section is not less than $15,000,000.
In paragraph (4) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b), the term “State” does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In this paragraph [42 U.S.C. 9922(b)(4)].

unit_attributes.statement: From funds made available under paragraphs (1)(B) and (2)(B) of 42 U.S.C. 9922(b) for any fiscal year, the Secretary must not make grants under subsection (a) to an eligible agency in an aggregate amount exceeding $50,000, and from funds made available under paragraph (2)(C) for any fiscal year, the Secretary must not make grants under subsection (a) to an eligible agency in an aggregate amount exceeding $300,000.

For each fiscal year, the Secretary must prepare and submit, to the Committee on Education and the Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Labor and Human Resources of the Senate, a report concerning the grants made under 42 U.S.C. 9922, including a list of grant recipients, information on the amount of funding awarded to each grant recipient, a summary of the activities performed by the grant recipients with funding awarded under this section, and a description of the manner in which such activities meet the objectives described in subsection (a).
unit_attributes.scope_text: For each fiscal year.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary is authorized to make a grant to an eligible service provider to administer national or regional programs to provide instructional activities for low-income youth.

In making a grant to an eligible service provider to administer national or regional programs to provide instructional activities for low-income youth, the Secretary must give priority to eligible service providers that have a demonstrated ability to operate such a program.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In making such a grant.

unit_attributes.statement: Any instructional activity carried out by an eligible service provider receiving a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9923 must be carried out on the campus of an institution of higher education (as defined in section 1141(a) of title 20) and must include: access to the facilities and resources of such an institution; an initial medical examination and follow-up referral or treatment, without charge, for youth during their participation in such activity; at least one nutritious meal daily, without charge, for participating youth during each day of participation; high quality instruction in a variety of sports (which must include swimming and may include dance and any other high quality recreational activity) provided by coaches and teachers from institutions of higher education and from elementary and secondary schools (as defined in section 7801 of title 20); and enrichment instruction and information on matters relating to the well-being of youth, including educational opportunities and information on study practices, education for the prevention of drug and alcohol abuse, and information on health and nutrition, career opportunities, and family and job responsibilities.
unit_attributes.actor: eligible service provider receiving a grant under this section
unit_attributes.actor_quote: eligible service provider receiving a grant under this section

unit_attributes.statement: The eligible service provider must, in each community in which a program is funded under 42 U.S.C. 9923, ensure that either a community-based advisory committee is established (with representatives from local youth, family, and social service organizations, schools, entities providing park and recreation services, and other community-based organizations serving high-risk youth) or an existing community-based advisory board, commission, or committee with similar membership is utilized to serve as that committee; and must enter into formal partnerships with youth-serving organizations or other appropriate social service entities in order to link program participants with year-round services in their home communities that support and continue the objectives of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In each community in which a program is funded under this section.
unit_attributes.choice_text: The provider must ensure that either a new community-based advisory committee is established or an existing advisory board, commission, or committee with similar membership is utilized.

unit_attributes.statement: A service provider that is a national private, nonprofit organization, a coalition of such organizations, or a private, nonprofit organization applying jointly with a business concern is eligible to apply for a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9923 if the applicant has demonstrated experience in operating a program providing instruction to low-income youth; agrees to contribute an amount (in cash or in kind, fairly evaluated) of not less than 25 percent of the amount requested, for the program funded through the grant; agrees to use no funds from a grant authorized under this section for administrative expenses; and agrees to comply with the regulations or program guidelines promulgated by the Secretary for use of funds made available through the grant.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If all specified conditions (1) through (4) are satisfied.

unit_attributes.statement: To be eligible to receive a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9923, a service provider must submit to the Secretary, for approval, an application at such time, in such manner, and containing such information as the Secretary may require.
unit_attributes.scope_text: To be eligible to receive a grant under this section.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary must promulgate regulations or program guidelines to ensure funds made available through a grant made under 42 U.S.C. 9923 are used in accordance with the objectives of this chapter.

Any reference in any provision of law to the poverty line set forth in section 624 or 625 of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964 must be construed to be a reference to the poverty line defined in section 9902 of title 42.

Except as otherwise provided, any reference in any provision of law to any community action agency designated under title II of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964 must be construed to be a reference to an entity eligible to receive funds under the community services block grant program.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as otherwise provided.

unit_attributes.statement: In order to stimulate the development of new approaches to provide for greater self-sufficiency of the poor, to test and evaluate such new approaches, to disseminate project results and evaluation findings so that such approaches can be replicated, and to strengthen the integration, coordination, and redirection of activities to promote maximum self-sufficiency among the poor, the Secretary may make grants from funds appropriated under subsection (e) to eligible entities for the development and implementation of new and innovative approaches to deal with particularly critical needs or problems of the poor which are common to a number of communities, but grants may be made only with respect to applications that involve activities that can be incorporated into or closely coordinated with eligible entities' ongoing programs, involve significant new combinations of resources or new and innovative approaches involving partnership agreements, are structured to most fully and effectively promote the purposes of the Community Services Block Grant Act within the limits of the contemplated assistance or activities, and contain an assurance that the applicant will obtain an independent, methodologically sound evaluation of the effectiveness of the activities and submit it to the Secretary.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Only with respect to applications meeting the conditions in subparagraphs (A) through (D).

unit_attributes.statement: No grant may be made under 42 U.S.C. 9925 unless an application is submitted to the Secretary at such time, in such manner, and containing or accompanied by such information, as the Secretary may require.
Initial and subsequent grant awards under 42 U.S.C. 9925 may fully fund projects for periods of up to 3 years.
Subject to subparagraph (B), grants awarded pursuant to 42 U.S.C. 9925 must be used for programs and must not exceed 50 per centum of the cost of such programs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to subparagraph (B).

unit_attributes.statement: After the first funding period for which an eligible entity receives a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9925 to carry out a program, the amount of a subsequent grant made under this section to such entity to carry out such program must not exceed 80 percent of the amount of the grant previously received by such entity under this section to carry out such program.
unit_attributes.scope_text: After the first funding period for which an eligible entity receives a grant under this section to carry out a program.

unit_attributes.statement: Non-Federal contributions under 42 U.S.C. 9925 may be in cash or in kind, fairly evaluated, including but not limited to plant, equipment, or services.

Not more than one grant in each fiscal year may be made to any eligible entity, no grant may exceed $350,000, and not more than 2 grants may be made under 42 U.S.C. 9925 to an eligible entity to carry out a particular program.

No application may be approved for assistance under 42 U.S.C. 9925 unless the Secretary is satisfied that the activities to be carried out under the application will be in addition to, and not in substitution for, activities previously carried on without Federal assistance, and that funds or other resources devoted to programs designed to meet the needs of the poor within the community, area, or State will not be diminished in order to provide the matching contributions required under this section.

In addition to the grant programs described in subsection (a), the Secretary may make grants to community action agencies for the purpose of enabling such agencies to demonstrate new approaches to dealing with the problems caused by entrenched, chronic unemployment and lack of economic opportunities for urban youth; demonstrations must include such activities as peer counseling, mentoring, development of job skills, assistance with social skills, community services, family literacy, parenting skills, opportunities for employment or entrepreneurship, and other services designed to assist such at-risk youth to continue their education, to secure meaningful employment, to perform community service, or to pursue other productive alternatives within the community.

Grants under 42 U.S.C. 9925(c) may be made only with respect to applications that identify and describe the population to be served, the problems to be addressed, the overall approach and methods of outreach and recruitment to be used, and the services to be provided; describe how the approach to be used differs from other approaches used for the population to be served by the project; describe the objectives of the project and contain a plan for measuring progress toward meeting those objectives; and contain assurances that the grantee will report on the progress and results of the demonstration at such times and in such manner as the Secretary requires.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Only with respect to applications meeting the requirements of subparagraphs (A) through (D).

unit_attributes.statement: Notwithstanding 42 U.S.C. 9925(b), grants under subsection (c) must not exceed 80 percent of the cost of such programs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Notwithstanding subsection (b).

unit_attributes.statement: Grants made under 42 U.S.C. 9925(c) on a competitive basis must be based on an annual competition determined by the Secretary, and grants made under this subsection must not exceed $500,000.

As soon as practicable, but not later than 180 days after the end of the fiscal year in which a recipient of a grant under 42 U.S.C. 9925 completes the expenditure of such grant, the Secretary must prepare and make available to each State and each eligible entity a description of the program carried out with such grant, any relevant information developed and results achieved, and a summary of the evaluation of such program received under subsection (a)(1)(D) so as to provide a model of innovative programs for other eligible entities.
unit_attributes.scope_text: As soon as practicable, but not later than 180 days after the end of the fiscal year in which a recipient of a grant under this section completes the expenditure of such grant.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary must annually identify programs that receive grants under 42 U.S.C. 9925 that demonstrate a significant potential for dealing with particularly critical needs or problems of the poor that exist in a number of communities.

Not less than 10 percent, and not more than 25 percent, of the funds appropriated for each fiscal year to carry out 42 U.S.C. 9925 must be available to make grants under this section to replicate in additional geographic areas programs identified under paragraph (1).

As used in 42 U.S.C. 9925, the term “eligible entity” has the same meaning given such term by section 673(1) of the Community Services Block Grant Act (42 U.S.C. 9902(1)), except that such term includes an organization that serves migrant and seasonal farm workers and that receives a grant under the Community Services Block Grant Act (42 U.S.C. 9901 et seq.) in the fiscal year preceding the fiscal year for which such organization requests a grant under this section.
unit_attributes.scope_text: As used in this section [42 U.S.C. 9925].

unit_attributes.statement: As used in 42 U.S.C. 9925, the term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Health and Human Services.
unit_attributes.scope_text: As used in this section [42 U.S.C. 9925].

unit_attributes.statement: Of the amounts appropriated for 42 U.S.C. 9925, not less than 30 percent and not more than 40 percent must be used to carry out the programs authorized under subsection (c).

In addition to sums required to carry out the evaluation, reporting, and dissemination of results under subsections (a), (c), (d), and (f) of 42 U.S.C. 9925, the Secretary is authorized to reserve up to 2 percent of the amounts appropriated pursuant to paragraphs (1) and (2) for administration of the program as well as for planning and technical assistance.
